name: IG30OL Oil-in-Water Sensor
shortDescription: Ultraviolet fluorescence detects oil in water for applications including petrochemical wastewater and oilfield reinjection monitoring. Optical filtering and a self-cleaning arrangement help manage measurement interference and deposits, while digital communication connects the probe to monitoring systems.
bodyHtml:
Product features:
◆The principle of ultraviolet fluorescence method for measuring oil in water has high accuracy and excellent correlation with infrared method
◆ Adopting titanium alloy corrosion-resistant shell; NPT3/4 threaded interface for easy installation
◆ With self-cleaning function, remove attachments from water samples, maintenance free
◆ Adopting unique optical and electronic filtering technology to eliminate the influence of ambient light on measurement
◆ Not affected by suspended particles in water
Application areas:
Standard discharge of petroleum and petrochemical wastewater, oil content control of oilfield reinjection water, inlet protection of boiler supplementary reverse osmosis membrane, and wastewater treatment
Technical parameters:
Measurement range: 0-10mg/L, 0-100mg/L,  0-1000mg/L
Measurement principle: UV fluorescence method
Measurement accuracy: ± 3% of the reading
Repeatability: less than ± 3%
Detection limit: 0.1 mg/L
Response time: 4 seconds
Calibration method: single point calibration
Water sample requirement: flow rate: 0-3m/s; Pressure: 0-100psi; 0-6bar; Temperature: 0-50 ℃
Communication interface: ModbusRS485
Threaded interface: standard 3/4NPT
Protection level: IP68
Installation methods: immersion type, circulation type
Cable length: Standard 10m, extendable
Electrode size: 176mm * 22mm
